description: This file contains the implementation of a Bootstrap v2.0.4 collapse component, including the Collapse class, plugin definition, and data-API for toggle behavior.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: A class managing the collapse/expand behavior of elements, including show, hide, toggle, and reset methods.

methods.name: Collapse
methods.description: Constructor for the Collapse class, initializing with element and options.

methods.name: dimension
methods.description: Returns the dimension ('width' or 'height') based on the element's classes.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Expands the collapse element, handling active siblings and transition.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the element's size to a specified value.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Handles the transition animation for show/hide.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles between show and hide states.
